mapper.sql: p.post_id AS postId, p.member_id AS memberId, m.nickname AS nickname, m.profile_image_url AS profileImageUrl, p.content AS content, p.language AS language, p.content_version AS contentVersion, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM community_comments c WHERE c.post_id = p.post_id ) AS commentCount, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM community_post_view_records v WHERE v.post_id = p.post_id ) AS viewCount, p.created_at AS createdAt, p.updated_at AS updatedAt
FROM community_posts p INNER JOIN members m ON p.member_id = m.member_id

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO community_posts ( member_id, content, language, content_version, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{memberId}, #{content}, #{language}, 1, NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.update: UPDATE community_posts SET content = #{content}, content_version = content_version + 1, updated_at = NOW() WHERE post_id = #{postId} AND member_id = #{memberId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO community_post_view_records ( post_id, member_id, visitor_token, viewed_at ) VALUES ( #{postId}, #{memberId}, #{visitorToken}, NOW() )

mapper.select: SELECT c.comment_id AS commentId, c.post_id AS postId, c.parent_comment_id AS parentCommentId, c.member_id AS memberId, m.nickname AS nickname, m.profile_image_url AS profileImageUrl, c.content AS content, c.content_version AS contentVersion, c.is_deleted AS deleted, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM community_comment_likes cl WHERE cl.comment_id = c.comment_id ) AS likeCount, CASE WHEN #{memberId} IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM community_comment_likes cl WHERE cl.comment_id = c.comment_id AND cl.member_id = #{memberId} ) THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS likedByMe, c.created_at AS createdAt, c.updated_at AS updatedAt FROM community_comments c INNER JOIN members m ON c.member_id = m.member_id WHERE c.post_id = #{postId} ORDER BY c.created_at ASC, c.comment_id ASC

SELECT c.comment_id AS commentId, c.post_id AS postId, c.parent_comment_id AS parentCommentId, c.member_id AS memberId, m.nickname AS nickname, m.profile_image_url AS profileImageUrl, c.content AS content, c.content_version AS contentVersion, c.is_deleted AS deleted, c.created_at AS createdAt, c.updated_at AS updatedAt FROM community_comments c INNER JOIN members m ON c.member_id = m.member_id WHERE c.comment_id = #{commentId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO community_comments ( post_id, member_id, parent_comment_id, content, content_version, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{postId}, #{memberId}, #{parentCommentId}, #{content}, 1, NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.update: UPDATE community_comments SET content = #{content}, content_version = content_version + 1, updated_at = NOW() WHERE comment_id = #{commentId} AND member_id = #{memberId} AND is_deleted = 0
UPDATE community_comments SET content = '삭제된 댓글입니다.', is_deleted = 1, updated_at = NOW() WHERE comment_id = #{commentId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO community_comment_likes (comment_id, member_id, created_at) VALUES (#{commentId}, #{memberId}, NOW())
INSERT INTO post_likes ( post_id, member_id, created_at ) VALUES ( #{postId}, #{memberId}, NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT m.member_id AS memberId, m.nickname AS nickname, m.profile_image_url AS profileImageUrl, COUNT(DISTINCT p.post_id) AS postCount, COUNT(pl.like_id) AS receivedLikeCount FROM members m LEFT JOIN community_posts p ON p.member_id = m.member_id LEFT JOIN post_likes pl ON pl.post_id = p.post_id WHERE m.member_id = #{memberId} GROUP BY m.member_id, m.nickname, m.profile_image_url
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO post_reposts ( post_id, member_id, created_at ) VALUES ( #{postId}, #{memberId}, NOW() )
